goal: Establish deterministic, versioned compatibility contracts for an intent-compiled ephemeral spatial workspace and freeze the Coding Spatial Workspace vertical slice without invoking operational UI or runtime behavior.
positive_requirements: Add deterministic ProjectContextProjection, EphemeralWorkspaceRecipe, SpatialReferentBinding, and MultimodalSpatialObservation V1 contracts.
Retain only references and digests to canonical truth owners.
Define CODING_SPATIAL_WORKSPACE_V1 as a review-only capability recipe.
Add Draft 2020-12 schemas and exact round-trip, stale-binding, authority, privacy, and no-invocation tests.
negative_requirements: Do not modify existing V1 manifest, Spatial, Compass, Forge, memory, runtime, renderer, or domain-owner source.
Do not create a project database, persistence store, second router, second renderer, second verifier, or second execution plane.
Do not invoke an organ, renderer, model, network, subprocess, filesystem mutation, source mutation, or domain mutation.
Do not retain raw camera, microphone, hand-joint, gaze, room-scan, or other raw sensor payloads.
Do not grant patch, execution, persistence, deployment, physical-work, payment, professional, model, sensor, renderer, commit, push, pull-request, or merge authority.
Do not regenerate CODEMAP or topology in this substantive PR.
exit_gates: Existing V1 manifest object, canonical JSON, and compute_digest output remain unchanged when wrapped.
Every new contract round-trips to exact canonical bytes and digest.
Nested authority aliases and raw sensor payload aliases fail closed.
Stale repository, project, scene, session, recipe, adapter, evidence, and entity identities fail closed.
Draft 2020-12 schemas validate exact records and reject authority escalation.
The contract module imports only stdlib and contains no operational or persistence invocation.
No generated navigation artifacts are changed.
